data: The no-partner branch in DMG 78034 requires a specified qualifying disability benefit, no adult normally residing with the claimant unless ignored, and no Carer’s Allowance payment or Universal Credit carer element for caring for them. Read the protected and ignored-person exceptions in DMG 78035–78036 and 78077–78080. DMG 78055–78057 distinguish actual payment from underlying entitlement. The heading Claimants who have no partner (including self-funders) governs DMG 78088: all conditions must still be met. It says normally self-funders and also the first four weeks while AA, DLA or PIP continues; funding status alone cannot prove continued qualification. Scottish-benefit memoranda are separate dated dependencies. Partner cases use DMG 78045–78050.
